edges: The Rose-in-Bloom was caught in the hurricane while offshore.
A large wave struck the Rose-in-Bloom, resulting in its overturning.
The overturning of the Rose-in-Bloom resulted in the deaths of 21 of its 48 passengers.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The hurricane killed more than 24 individuals along the entirety of its track.
The hurricane caused extreme rainfall upon arriving in New England.
